idea: Freight Railroad Operational Delays via Weekly Shipping News Volume

data.source: RSS feed counts from railway industry news sources (Progressive Railroading, Railway Age)

behavior: Spikes in railroad delay and operational issue reporting correlate with freight bottlenecks and logistics stress, which historically precedes industrial sector weakness.

market_impact.rationale: Industrial companies depend on reliable rail transport; delays signal supply chain friction and near-term margin pressure.

trade_logic.entry: When weekly RSS count for 'railroad delay' or 'rail congestion' exceeds 90th percentile of trailing 12-week average by >40%
trade_logic.exit: After 10 trading days or when RSS count returns to median

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Railroad operational issues are frequent and seasonal; logistics disruptions occur multiple times per quarter, making this a reliable monthly signal.

idea: Natural Gas Heating Demand Spike via Weather Extremes

data.source: Open-Meteo daily temperature anomalies (heating degree days) for US bulk weighted by population

behavior: Sudden cold snaps drive heating demand spikes, raising natural gas input pressure and energy sector volatility within 7–14 days.

market_impact.rationale: Energy producers benefit from sustained demand spikes; natural gas futures and integrated energy stocks rally on weather-driven input scarcity.

trade_logic.entry: When 5-day rolling average heating degree days exceeds 95th percentile threshold AND daily low temperature drops >8°F from prior week average
trade_logic.exit: After 7 trading days or when heating degree days return below 60th percentile

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Weather extremes are frequent October–March; cold snaps occur multiple times per winter, triggering frequent signals.

idea: Google Trends Surge in Pest Control Searches Signals Consumer Home Stress

data.source: Google Trends weekly search interest for 'pest control near me' and 'termite treatment'

behavior: Surges in pest control search interest often spike in spring and fall, signaling homeowner stress and reactive spending on home maintenance.

market_impact.rationale: Consumer discretionary home services and maintenance spending correlates with confidence; pest control searches precede broader home improvement cycles.

trade_logic.entry: When weekly Google Trends index for pest control searches exceeds 70 (on 0–100 scale) and increases >20 points week-over-week
trade_logic.exit: After 14 trading days or when index falls below 55

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Seasonal pest activity spikes occur reliably in spring (March–May) and fall (August–October), generating predictable signals multiple times per year.

idea: Earthquake Activity Surge Triggers Defensive Rotation

data.source: USGS earthquake activity API (magnitude ≥4.5 in continental US) daily count and regional clustering

behavior: Clusters of moderate seismic events in populated regions drive risk-off sentiment and brief rotation to defensive sectors within 2–5 trading days.

market_impact.rationale: Earthquake fears trigger temporary flight to safety; discretionary spending appetite declines as consumer confidence dips.

trade_logic.entry: When 3-day rolling count of magnitude ≥4.5 earthquakes in CA or PNW ≥3 events AND event occurs within 500km of metro area (pop >1M)
trade_logic.exit: After 5 trading days or when S&P 500 VIX falls below prior 10-day mean

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Seismic activity is natural and frequent; California and Oregon experience moderate earthquakes multiple times per month on average.

idea: Labor Force Participation Drop via Jobs Report Surprise

data.source: FRED series CIVPART (civilian labor force participation rate) weekly through fred_series adapter

behavior: Sudden drops in labor force participation (>0.2% weekly decline) signal worker discouragement or health/demographic shocks, bearish for consumer discretionary.

market_impact.rationale: Lower participation reduces wage pressure and consumer spending capacity; discretionary companies face demand headwinds.

trade_logic.entry: When weekly FRED CIVPART reading drops >0.2 percentage points from prior week AND is below 20-week moving average
trade_logic.exit: After 10 trading days or when CIVPART rebounds above 20-week MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Labor force participation fluctuates seasonally and cyclically; drops >0.2% occur several times per year during economic transitions.

idea: Airline Seat Load Factor Compression Signals Travel Weakness

data.source: BTS airline load factor (available seat miles vs. revenue passenger miles) weekly proxy via port/airline data feeds

behavior: Falling load factors (more empty seats) precede airline margin compression and broader discretionary travel slowdown by 1–3 weeks.

market_impact.rationale: Airline weakness signals consumer travel confidence deterioration; hospitality and leisure stocks follow within 2 weeks.

trade_logic.entry: When weekly aggregate US airline load factor falls >2.5 percentage points from prior month average AND closes below 80% capacity utilization
trade_logic.exit: After 7 trading days or when load factor rebounds above 82%

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Airline load factors vary seasonally and cyclically; drops >2.5% occur multiple times per quarter during demand transitions.

idea: Retail Store Closure Announcements via News Count Spike

data.source: RSS feed counts from retail trade publications (RetailDive, Chain Store Age) for 'store closure' and 'retail consolidation'

behavior: Clusters of retail closure announcements signal sector distress and consumer spending pullback, weak forward guidance for retail landlords and suppliers.

market_impact.rationale: Real estate investors (REITs) and landlords suffer from vacancies; retail space values decline as closures accelerate.

trade_logic.entry: When weekly RSS count for 'store closure' OR 'retail consolidation' exceeds 75th percentile of trailing 12-week average AND is >8 articles per week
trade_logic.exit: After 14 trading days or when article count returns to median

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Retail consolidation is ongoing; closure announcements occur frequently (especially post-earnings), generating signals multiple times per quarter.

idea: EV Charger Network Growth Slowdown Signals Green Energy Weakness

data.source: OpenChargeMap EV charger location counts (total installed and operational) weekly snapshot

behavior: Slowdown or plateau in EV charger installation pace signals weakening clean energy sector momentum and policy/subsidy concerns.

market_impact.rationale: Slower EV infrastructure build suggests reduced clean energy capital deployment and investor sentiment downturn in renewables.

trade_logic.entry: When weekly net new EV chargers installed falls below 5th percentile of trailing 12-week rolling average AND cumulative growth rate <2% month-over-month
trade_logic.exit: After 10 trading days or when installation rate rebounds above 25th percentile

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: EV charger growth fluctuates seasonally and with policy shifts; slowdowns occur 2–3 times per year during funding cycles or subsidy transitions.

idea: Corporate Debt Issuance Volume Drop via Bond Market Stress

data.source: FRED series TERMCBCCALLNS (corporate bond spreads) daily through fred_series adapter, paired with volume proxies from financial news RSS

behavior: Spikes in corporate bond spreads combined with declining issuance signal credit stress; financial and industrial equities weaken within 3–7 days.

market_impact.rationale: Rising bond spreads reflect credit market dysfunction; financial institutions and investment-grade borrowers face funding pressure.

trade_logic.entry: When daily corporate bond spread (TERMCBCCALLNS) exceeds 20-day moving average by >15 basis points AND spreads move >10 bps higher day-over-day
trade_logic.exit: After 7 trading days or when spreads contract below 20-day MA

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Corporate bond spreads widen frequently during volatile macro periods; >15 bps spikes occur multiple times per quarter.

idea: Google Trends Surge in Bankruptcy Search Terms Signals Consumer Debt Stress

data.source: Google Trends weekly search interest for 'bankruptcy filing' and 'debt consolidation near me'

behavior: Spikes in bankruptcy and debt-related searches correlate with consumer financial stress cycles; lead indicator for credit card delinquencies and loan defaults.

market_impact.rationale: Banks and financial institutions face rising default risk; credit card issuers and consumer lenders see margin compression.

trade_logic.entry: When weekly Google Trends index for 'bankruptcy filing' or 'debt consolidation' exceeds 65 AND increases >15 points week-over-week from prior week
trade_logic.exit: After 14 trading days or when index falls below 50

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Consumer debt stress searches spike regularly during economic slowdowns and rate hikes; signals occur 2–4 times per year with high consistency.
